name: moirai_integrate
description: Wire the annotated application to moirai - environment, compile and link flags, build. Load for the integrate stage.

history.why: Tool-design fault found at the annotate gate (pipeline elmerfold-prov-20261030-125944): annotate_validate could not pass because it tried to check moirai_env.sh, which this stage writes after annotate. The PYTHONPATH rule belongs here. integrate_validate now checks that moirai_env.sh exists, exports PYTHONPATH naming the annotated root (env_pythonpath), and that `import moirai, _moirai_prov` resolves when that env file is sourced in a clean environment with no inherited PYTHONPATH (env_import); the old python_import check injected PYTHONPATH itself and so never proved the env file works. Adds integrate_env_check so the check is testable without a pipeline. Companion to the prov_annotate proposal that turns helper_on_pythonpath into a deferred note.
